name: Gaià (Spain)
description: Divided per bend sinister light blue and yellow, the light blue with the white fleur-de-lis and crescent of the arms, the yellow with four red bars.
history: The flag was published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya on 6 April 1999; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, bicolour per bend sinister light blue and yellow, with the white fleur-de-lis and crescent of the arms (approved 29 May 1997, attributes of the Virgin), the whole half the height, and the lower part with four red bars.

features.role: four red bars on the yellow
